# package-file-nand.txt — RKAF manifest for the NAND-rootfs update.img variant.
#
# vs package-file-aes.txt: adds the rootfs row so afptool bundles rootfs.ubi.img,
# and boot is the no-ramdisk FIT (boot-nand.img, staged under the name boot.img
# by assemble-update.sh --nand). Flashing the resulting update-nand.img writes
# uboot + boot + rootfs in one go — the full persistent-NAND-rootfs path.
#
# To flash only uboot+boot and keep the initramfs-shell rescue variant, use
# package-file-aes.txt instead (assemble-update.sh without --nand).

# NAME		Relative path
package-file	package-file
bootloader	Image/MiniLoaderAll.bin
parameter	Image/parameter.txt
uboot		Image/uboot.img
boot		Image/boot.img
rootfs		Image/rootfs.img
